hand-entered.name: constants.ts COUNTRY_BASE_DATA, hand-entered without a recorded source, year or retrieval date (frozen verbatim at commit bb85a92)

conventions.gdpPerCapita: US$ per person per year; NOMINAL, base year undocumented (roughly 2019-2021 current US$). Not constant 2015 US$.
conventions.governance: hand-assigned 0-1 "institutional quality" score; not any named index (Spearman rho 0.93 with WGI Government Effectiveness, data/provenance/README.md)

wellbeingAnchor.note: The coefficients the engine used before the migration (simulation/pure.ts at bb85a92), rounded to 3 decimals. `fit` is the unrounded refit by scripts/countries/anchorFit.ts on this dataset's governance column and data/hindcast (ladder x 10 on ln NY.GDP.PCAP.KD), which reproduces them.
